modules.title: 从用户目标与顾虑，到首页实际内容

example.label: 用待验证的用户画像假设调整首页

steps.label: 记录目标与顾虑
steps.demo:
画像假设 · 尚待访谈核实
目标让潜在客户快速看到作品
顾虑自己不会搭建和维护网站
依据先列为假设；不补年龄等未知信息
steps.caption: 画像要整理真实行为、目标和顾虑。这里展示的是待核实的示例假设，不是某次真实调研结论。

steps.label: 对应首页内容
steps.demo:
portfolio.example
给独立创作者的作品集

把你的作品整理成客户看得见的作品集

从现成版式开始，不用先学会写代码。

从模板开始
steps.caption: 标题把目标说成可见作品，说明和入口回应不会搭建网站的顾虑；是否有效仍要让目标用户实际阅读和操作。

steps.label: 向用户核对
steps.demo:
下一轮核对 · 观察真实理解
目标是否清楚看完首屏后，请用户说说能做什么
顾虑是否回应请用户尝试找到开始制作作品集的入口
还不能下的结论不能仅凭画像假设断定所有人都会理解
steps.caption: 画像帮助团队提出有依据的页面假设；用户能否看懂和找到入口，需要通过真实访谈或使用观察验证。

modules.title: 画像如何指导页面判断

items.title: 文案写给谁
items.text: 从真实访谈或使用记录归纳目标、行为和顾虑，再检查标题、说明与入口有没有回应它们；没有证据的年龄等特征不应补写。

items.title: 先做什么
items.text: 目标和场景可以帮助比较方案优先级；画像提出判断依据，但不能代替业务决策或用户验证。

items.title: 验收有依据
items.text: 把“目标用户能否看懂这句话、找到下一步”变成可以通过访谈或页面观察核对的问题。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 画像是从证据归纳出的代表性模型，不等于凭空编一个年龄、职业和姓名，也不代表每个用户都一样。缺少研究依据时，清楚标注待验证的假设，再用访谈或使用观察核对。

lessonPractice.title: 访谈记录显示，独立设计师想让客户看到作品，但担心自己不会搭建网站。首页第一屏该优先放什么？

options.label: 先突出作品展示和容易开始的入口，再用访谈确认文案是否打消顾虑
options.feedback: 对。作品展示回应了让客户看见作品的目标，明确的开始入口回应了不会搭建网站的顾虑；上线前仍要找目标用户核对。

options.label: 先罗列全部产品功能，让访客自己判断适不适合
options.feedback: 功能清单没有回应作品如何展示，也没有说明不会搭建的人怎样开始。

options.label: 给首页加上“35 岁以上用户适用”来具体说明受众
options.feedback: 记录里没有年龄依据；画像要用实际目标、行为和顾虑做判断，不能凭空补人口特征。

en.title: Interviews suggest freelance designers want clients to see their work but worry they cannot build a website. What should the homepage show first?

options.label: Lead with a portfolio and an easy way to get started, then check the copy with interviewees
options.feedback: Correct. A portfolio supports the goal of showing work, and a clear start path addresses the concern about building a site. Validate the copy with target users before release.

options.label: List every product feature and let visitors decide whether it fits
options.feedback: A feature list does not explain how to show work or how someone with no site-building experience can start.

options.label: Add 'for users over 35' to make the audience specific
options.feedback: The notes give no evidence for age. Base the persona on observed goals, behavior, and concerns instead of inventing demographics.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请根据这份访谈记录调整首页：“独立设计师希望客户能快速看到作品，也担心自己不会搭建网站。”先把它当作待验证的画像假设，不补写年龄等没有依据的信息。让首屏文案和入口分别回应目标与顾虑，并标出还需要向用户核实的判断。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Use these interview notes to revise the homepage: 'Freelance designers want clients to see their work quickly and worry they cannot build a website.' Treat this as a persona hypothesis to validate; do not invent an age or other unsupported detail. Make the headline and first action address the goal and concern, and list what still needs user validation.

references.title: 用户画像与 Jobs to Be Done 的区别
references.title_en: Personas vs. Jobs to Be Done

learning.assumes: You are unsure who a product or page is written for, or the team describes the target user differently.
learning.outcome: You can point to the homepage copy or action that addresses a persona's goal and concern.

modules.title: Connect user goals and concerns to homepage content

example.label: Adjust a homepage using a persona hypothesis to validate

steps.label: Record goal and concern
steps.demo:
Persona hypothesis · interview validation pending
GoalHelp potential clients see work quickly
ConcernCannot build or maintain a website
BasisMark as a hypothesis; do not invent an age
steps.caption: A persona should synthesize observed behavior, goals, and concerns. This is an illustrative hypothesis to validate, not a claim about a real study.

steps.label: Match the homepage content
steps.demo:
portfolio.example
A portfolio for independent creators

Turn your work into a portfolio clients can see

Start from a ready-made layout—no coding experience needed.

Start with a template
steps.caption: The headline names the visible goal; the description and first action address the concern about building a site. Users still need to read and try the page.

steps.label: Check with users
steps.demo:
Next check · observe real understanding
Is the goal clear?Ask what someone can do after reading the first screen
Is the concern addressed?Ask them to find how to start a portfolio
What remains unknown?A persona hypothesis cannot predict whether every user understands
steps.caption: A persona helps the team state a page hypothesis. Interviews or usage observation must check whether people understand it and find the next step.

modules.title: How a persona guides page decisions

items.title: Who the copy speaks to
items.text: Synthesize goals, behavior, and concerns from interviews or usage notes, then check whether the heading, copy, and action respond. Do not add unsupported details such as age.

items.title: What to do first
items.text: Goals and context help compare priorities, but a persona supplies evidence for a decision—it does not replace product judgment or user validation.

items.title: Acceptance has a basis
items.text: Turn 'Can the target user understand this and find the next step?' into a question to check in an interview or page observation.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: A persona is a representative model synthesized from evidence, not an invented age, job, and name, and it does not describe every user. When research is missing, label assumptions for validation and check them through interviews or usage observation.

distinctions.label: Market segment
distinctions.text: A market segment divides people into groups by data; a persona concentrates one group into a single person for alignment.

distinctions.label: User journey
distinctions.text: A user journey describes behavior over time; a persona describes who this is.
